name: LockIn — Strict Schedule Site Blocker
description: Block distracting sites on a schedule. Strict mode locks the block on until your session ends — no mid-session disabling.

_permission_justifications.storage: Stores the user's blocked-site list, schedules, strict mode flag, streak history, and plan status in chrome.storage.local. Nothing is sent to an external server except an anonymous paid-status check.
_permission_justifications.alarms: Fires once per minute in the background so the active schedule can be re-evaluated and blocking rules re-applied even while no popup/options page is open, including re-locking strict mode if the service worker was asleep.
_permission_justifications.declarativeNetRequest: Used only to block navigation (main_frame requests) to the domains the user typed in, and only while one of their schedules is active. Rules are generated entirely from local, user-entered data; no host_permissions are requested and no page content is read or modified.
